description: iterative fan-out over docs whose round-1 files refer to a runbook no round-1 sub-task names: the gap shows only after round 1, so full coverage needs round 2; the reducer's result is scored against the planted facts (coverage loop)

dispatch.title: Collect the payouts facts
dispatch.task: List every operational fact in the payouts docs under /work/docs, each with the file it comes from, following every document they refer to.
context: The docs start with two short Markdown files under /work/docs: payouts.md and chargebacks.md. A document may refer to others under /work/docs.

worker.instructions: Read only the file your sub-task names. State each operational fact in it on its own line and cite the file in the form (file.md). Then add one line `REFERS TO: <path>` for each other document the file refers to.

evaluator.instructions: A document is covered when a branch has listed its facts. For each document a branch says its file REFERS TO that no branch has covered yet, write one feedback line: `List every operational fact in /work/docs/<path>.` Pass only when no such document is left.

reducer.instructions: Merge the branch results into one list: one fact per line, each ending with its source file in the form (file.md). Keep every fact from every round; drop duplicates and the REFERS TO lines.

params.coverage_criteria: Every document under /work/docs that a covered document refers to is itself covered, and every operational fact of every covered document is listed with its file.

returns.shape: one operational fact per line, each ending with its source file in the form (file.md)
